7.description: The Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee approved its 2026 work plan, focusing on reviewing heritage policy, awards, and intangible heritage.

chips.text: Subcommittees were abolished due to difficulties in coordinating meetings.
Past heritage award winners desire a visual identity for recognition.
Advisory committees now have a $2,000 budget; council must approve more.
Staff will circulate the heritage policy document and attach it to the next agenda.

8.description: The Committee renewed annual memberships for the National Trust for Canada ($52.50), Heritage Saskatchewan, and the Saskatoon Heritage Society ($30).

chips.text: Councillor Ford questioned the benefits of the National Trust for Canada membership.

9.description: City administration will meet with the Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee to prioritize and address parts of the Official Community Plan and Heritage Plan and Policy.

chips.text: Council renewed memberships for National Trust, Heritage Saskatchewan

24.description: The Committee reviewed its subcommittees, confirming they can be established, disbanded, or created ad hoc based on need.

10.description: The committee deferred a decision on sponsoring a Saskatoon Heritage Society event, seeking more information on other potential funding sources.

chips.text: A councillor questioned if the Heritage Society was 'double-dipping' on funding requests.
Saskatoon Heritage Society requested event sponsorship up to $5,000.
The committee needed to know if the Heritage Society had applied for other city funding.
Administration will contact other city divisions about confirmed funding for the event.

19.description: Saskatoon approved payment for membership fees listed in items 9.1 and 9.2.

12.description: The committee discussed future budgeting for events, including potential allocations for 2027, and plans to review an upcoming Request for Proposals.

chips.text: A staff member promised to return to the committee with future event budget details.

14.description: The committee recommends Council receive information that the 2025 subcommittees were disbanded and will be removed from future agendas.
